name: Cislunar-Hypostyle
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs tectonic rift valleys, stark under a black sky.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on platinum and titanium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
